verdict.rationale: Caveman documents its own automations that run by hand, on a schedule, or on a GitHub event, and says chats keep running on a Cloud computer after the laptop lid closes. That is real unattended, event-driven execution. However, the evidence never describes a headless or non-interactive CLI mode or running the open-source CLI inside a CI pipeline, and there is no independent corroboration. missing for 10: documented headless/non-interactive CLI flags, CI pipeline integration docs (e.g., a GitHub Action or CI config examples), hands-on or community corroboration of automated runs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: Automations that run by hand, on a schedule or on a GitHub event.
working chats continue on a Cloud computer when the lid closes.
The open-source Caveman CLI wraps supported agents including Claude Code, Codex, and Gemini CLI.
